recycle.usageZh: 动词：回收 recycle paper/glass。名词 recycling；形容词 recyclable。recycle bin。

examples.sentence: We recycle glass every Friday.
examples.trans: 我们每周五回收玻璃。

examples.sentence: She recycles jars into vases.
examples.trans: 她把罐子回收成花瓶。

examples.sentence: The street recycles more than it used to.
examples.trans: 这条街回收得比以前多。

examples.sentence: A city that cannot recycle food waste will still pay for it later.
examples.trans: 不能回收厨余的城市，稍后仍会付钱。

examples.sentence: They recycled rainwater for the trees.
examples.trans: 他们把雨水回收给树用。

examples.sentence: Recycling without buyers is just a prettier landfill.
examples.trans: 没有买家的回收，只是更好看的填埋。

environment.usageZh: 名词：环境 the environment。形容词 environmental；副词 environmentally。

examples.sentence: Keep the environment clean.
examples.trans: 保持环境清洁。

examples.sentence: Smoke harms the environment near the factory.
examples.trans: 烟损害工厂附近的环境。

examples.sentence: A noisy environment makes bees work harder.
examples.trans: 嘈杂的环境让蜜蜂更辛苦。

examples.sentence: The environment is not a backdrop for selfies.
examples.trans: 环境不是自拍的背景布。

examples.sentence: They measured the environment in shade, not only in slogans.
examples.trans: 他们用树荫而不是口号来衡量环境。

examples.sentence: An environment that cannot reproduce insects will not reproduce harvests.
examples.trans: 无法让昆虫繁殖的环境，也无法让收获繁殖。

waste.usageZh: 可作名词 food/plastic waste；动词 waste time/water。形容词 wasteful。

examples.sentence: Do not waste water.
examples.trans: 不要浪费水。

examples.sentence: Food waste fills the wrong bin.
examples.trans: 厨余进了错误的桶。

examples.sentence: They wasted heat by leaving windows open in winter.
examples.trans: 冬天开窗浪费了热。

examples.sentence: Waste that could be soil is still called rubbish.
examples.trans: 本可以变成土壤的废物仍被称为垃圾。

examples.sentence: The factory wasted raw materials in a leak no one named.
examples.trans: 工厂在无人点名的泄漏里浪费原料。

examples.sentence: A culture of waste is a culture of cheap hours and expensive futures.
examples.trans: 浪费的文化，是廉价钟点与昂贵未来的文化。

process.usageZh: 可数名词：过程 recycling process；动词 process 加工。in the process。

examples.sentence: Recycling is a long process.
examples.trans: 回收是一个长过程。

examples.sentence: They process glass into new bottles.
examples.trans: 他们把玻璃加工成新瓶子。

examples.sentence: In the process, bees lost flowers.
examples.trans: 在这过程中，蜜蜂失去了花。

examples.sentence: A process that hides its smoke is still a process.
examples.trans: 藏起烟雾的过程仍是过程。

examples.sentence: The city processed rain as a problem, not as a gift.
examples.trans: 这座城把雨当问题处理，不当礼物。

examples.sentence: Industrial processes borrow rivers and rarely return them intact.
examples.trans: 工业过程借用河流，很少完好归还。

damage.usageZh: 不可数名词为主：do/cause damage to；动词 damage。形容词 damaging。

examples.sentence: Storms damage roofs.
examples.trans: 风暴损坏屋顶。

examples.sentence: Plastic does damage to fish.
examples.trans: 塑料伤害鱼。

examples.sentence: The leak damaged the stored paper.
examples.trans: 泄漏损坏了存放的纸。

examples.sentence: Heat damage to bees is a farm problem, not a hobby.
examples.trans: 对蜜蜂的热损害是农业问题，不是爱好。

examples.sentence: They counted damage in lost shade, not only broken glass.
examples.trans: 他们用失去的树荫而不只是碎玻璃来计算损害。

examples.sentence: Damage delayed is still damage; it only changes whose children pay.
examples.trans: 被推迟的损害仍是损害；只是换了谁的孩子来付。

global.usageZh: 形容词：全球的 global warming。副词 globally；名词 globe。

examples.sentence: This is a global map.
examples.trans: 这是一张世界地图。

examples.sentence: Global winds carry smoke far.
examples.trans: 全球的风把烟带得很远。

examples.sentence: Global warming is local in a kitchen without a fan.
examples.trans: 全球变暖在没有风扇的厨房里是本地的。

examples.sentence: A global promise needs a local bin.
examples.trans: 全球承诺需要一个本地的桶。

examples.sentence: They felt a global trend as fewer birds at dawn.
examples.trans: 他们把全球趋势感受成黎明鸟更少。

examples.sentence: Global markets can hide local shortages behind cheap shelves.
examples.trans: 全球市场能在便宜货架后藏起本地短缺。

separate.usageZh: 动词：分开 separate waste；形容词 separate 分开的。副词 separately。

examples.sentence: Separate the paper from the food.
examples.trans: 把纸和食物分开。

examples.sentence: They keep glass in a separate bin.
examples.trans: 他们把玻璃放在单独的桶里。

examples.sentence: The river separates the factory from the school.
examples.trans: 河把工厂和学校分开。

examples.sentence: Separate collections fail if the truck mixes them later.
examples.trans: 如果卡车稍后又混在一起，分类收集就失败了。

examples.sentence: Heat and bees cannot live in separate stories forever.
examples.trans: 热和蜜蜂不能永远活在分开的故事里。

examples.sentence: A separate 'environment department' cannot separate the air from the budget.
examples.trans: 单独的“环境部门”无法把空气从预算里分开。

category.usageZh: 可数名词：类别 a category of waste。动词 categorize；形容词 categorical。

examples.sentence: Paper is one category.
examples.trans: 纸是一个类别。

examples.sentence: Put bottles in the right category.
examples.trans: 把瓶子放进正确类别。

examples.sentence: Food waste is a category that can become soil.
examples.trans: 厨余是一类可以变成土壤的东西。

examples.sentence: A category called 'other' is where systems hide.
examples.trans: 叫做“其他”的类别，是系统躲藏的地方。

examples.sentence: They added a category for batteries after the fire.
examples.trans: 火灾后他们加了电池类别。

examples.sentence: If harm has no category, it will not have a truck.
examples.trans: 如果伤害没有类别，它就不会有一辆卡车。

material.usageZh: 可数名词：材料 raw material。形容词 material 物质的。副词 materially。

examples.sentence: Glass is a useful material.
examples.trans: 玻璃是有用的材料。

examples.sentence: They reuse old material for roofs.
examples.trans: 他们把旧材料再用到屋顶上。

examples.sentence: Raw materials come from somewhere with a name.
examples.trans: 原材料来自一个有名字的地方。

examples.sentence: A material that cannot be recycled should be harder to buy.
examples.trans: 不能回收的材料应该更难买到。

examples.sentence: The report treated bees as a material, then wondered why they left.
examples.trans: 报告把蜜蜂当材料，然后奇怪它们为何离开。

examples.sentence: Material wealth that strips shade is a short kind of rich.
examples.trans: 剥掉树荫的物质财富，是一种短的富。

energy.usageZh: 不可数名词：能源/精力 solar energy。形容词 energetic。energy-saving。

examples.sentence: Save energy: turn off the lamp.
examples.trans: 节约能源：关灯。

examples.sentence: Solar energy dries the clothes.
examples.trans: 太阳能把衣服烘干。

examples.sentence: The city wastes energy in empty, bright offices at night.
examples.trans: 城市在夜间空亮的办公室里浪费能源。

examples.sentence: Bee energy is also a kind of farm energy.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂的能量也是一种农业能量。

examples.sentence: They measured energy in hours of unpaid cooling.
examples.trans: 他们用无偿降温的时数来测量能源。

examples.sentence: Clean energy that still burns a forest is a naming trick.
examples.trans: 仍然烧掉森林的清洁能源，是一种命名把戏。

reusable.usageZh: 形容词：可重复使用的 reusable bottle。动词 reuse；反义 disposable。

examples.sentence: Bring a reusable cup.
examples.trans: 带可重复使用的杯子。

examples.sentence: Reusable bags survived the market better than slogans.
examples.trans: 可再用袋子比口号更能在市场活下来。

examples.sentence: A reusable bottle still needs clean water.
examples.trans: 可再用瓶子仍需要干净的水。

examples.sentence: They replaced disposables with reusable trays in the canteen.
examples.trans: 食堂用可再用托盘替换一次性的。

examples.sentence: Reusable systems fail when washing them is unpaid.
examples.trans: 清洗无人付酬时，可再用系统会失败。

examples.sentence: A reusable city is one that does not throw away its shade.
examples.trans: 可再用的城市，是不扔掉树荫的城市。

raw.usageZh: 形容词：生的、未加工的 raw materials/food。raw data。

examples.sentence: Do not eat raw meat here.
examples.trans: 这里不要吃生肉。

examples.sentence: Raw vegetables from the garden tasted loud.
examples.trans: 园子里的生蔬菜味道很冲。

examples.sentence: Raw materials leave scars where they are taken.
examples.trans: 原材料在被取走的地方留下伤疤。

examples.sentence: The report published raw numbers, not only neat totals.
examples.trans: 报告公布了原始数字，而不只是整齐总计。

examples.sentence: Raw heat without trees cooks a street.
examples.trans: 没有树的生热会烹调一条街。

examples.sentence: A politics of raw extraction calls itself growth.
examples.trans: 生提取的政治自称增长。

reduce.usageZh: 动词：减少 reduce waste/emissions。名词 reduction。

examples.sentence: Reduce plastic this month.
examples.trans: 这个月减少塑料。

examples.sentence: They reduced litter by adding bins.
examples.trans: 他们加了桶，减少了乱扔。

examples.sentence: Farms reduced poison and the birds returned.
examples.trans: 农场减少了毒药，鸟回来了。

examples.sentence: To reduce heat, plant shade, not only fans.
examples.trans: 要降温，就种树荫，而不只是风扇。

examples.sentence: The city reduced night lights and found more stars and more fear.
examples.trans: 城市减少夜灯，发现了更多星星和更多恐惧。

examples.sentence: Reductions that only exist on slides will not cool a room.
examples.trans: 只存在于幻灯片上的减少，凉不了一间屋。

reuse.usageZh: 动词：再用 reuse a jar。名词 reuse。与 recycle 近，reuse 不经再加工。

examples.sentence: Reuse the jar for rice.
examples.trans: 把罐子再用来装米。

examples.sentence: They reuse rain for the trees.
examples.trans: 他们把雨水再用来浇树。

examples.sentence: Reuse comes before recycle in a wise order.
examples.trans: 在聪明的顺序里，再用先于回收。

examples.sentence: A shop that reuses boxes still prints too many flyers.
examples.trans: 再用纸箱的店仍打印太多传单。

examples.sentence: She reused yesterday's tea leaves for the plants.
examples.trans: 她把昨天的茶叶再用来浇花。

examples.sentence: Reuse that depends on unpaid washing is a hidden tax.
examples.trans: 依赖无偿清洗的再用，是一种暗税。

species.usageZh: 单复同形名词：物种 a species / many species。endangered species。

examples.sentence: This bird is a rare species.
examples.trans: 这鸟是稀有物种。

examples.sentence: Many species need flowers that cities cut.
examples.trans: 许多物种需要城市剪掉的花。

examples.sentence: A species that cannot reproduce in heat will leave the map.
examples.trans: 无法在热中繁殖的物种会离开地图。

examples.sentence: They counted species at dawn, when the street was still honest.
examples.trans: 他们黎明数物种，那时街道还诚实。

examples.sentence: Protecting one famous species while paving the rest is a poster.
examples.trans: 保护一个著名物种却铺掉其余的，是海报。

examples.sentence: Species are not decorations for a global brand.
examples.trans: 物种不是全球品牌的装饰。

litter.usageZh: 不可数名词：乱扔的垃圾；动词 litter。litter bin。

examples.sentence: Do not drop litter.
examples.trans: 不要乱扔垃圾。

examples.sentence: The park was littered after the concert.
examples.trans: 音乐会后公园遍地垃圾。

examples.sentence: Litter in the river becomes a fish's meal.
examples.trans: 河里的垃圾会变成鱼的饭。

examples.sentence: They treated flowers as litter and wondered where bees went.
examples.trans: 他们把花当垃圾，然后奇怪蜜蜂去哪了。

examples.sentence: A street without bins will be littered by design.
examples.trans: 没有桶的街道会在设计上被弄脏。

examples.sentence: Litter is a public letter about unpaid care.
examples.trans: 垃圾是一封关于无偿照护的公开信。

decrease.usageZh: 动词/名词：减少 decrease in/by。反义 increase。

examples.sentence: Noise will decrease after ten.
examples.trans: 十点后噪声会减少。

examples.sentence: Bee numbers decreased in the heat.
examples.trans: 炎热中蜜蜂数量减少。

examples.sentence: A decrease in shade is an increase in hospital visits.
examples.trans: 树荫减少就是医院就诊增加。

examples.sentence: They decreased plastic and increased time at the tap.
examples.trans: 他们减少塑料，增加了在水龙头边的时间。

examples.sentence: The graph decreased only because the factory moved next door.
examples.trans: 图表下降只是因为工厂搬到了隔壁。

examples.sentence: Decreases announced without a truck schedule are wishes.
examples.trans: 没有卡车时刻表的减少宣布，是愿望。

bin.usageZh: 可数名词：垃圾桶 a recycle bin。动词 bin 扔掉（英）。

examples.sentence: Put paper in this bin.
examples.trans: 把纸放进这个桶。

examples.sentence: The bin was full of bottles.
examples.trans: 桶里满是瓶子。

examples.sentence: A missing bin teaches the street to litter.
examples.trans: 缺失的桶教街道乱扔。

examples.sentence: They stood the bin in the shade so the smell stayed kind.
examples.trans: 他们把桶放在树荫里，让气味保持友善。

examples.sentence: Night bins overflow when day speeches end.
examples.trans: 白天演说结束时，夜里的桶会溢出。

examples.sentence: A city of slogans with too few bins is a dare to its poorest street.
examples.trans: 口号很多、桶很少的城市，是对最穷街道的挑衅。

discuss.usageZh: 动词：讨论 discuss sth（不说 discuss about）。名词 discussion。

examples.sentence: Let's discuss the bins.
examples.trans: 我们来讨论这些桶。

examples.sentence: They discussed heat before they discussed flowers.
examples.trans: 他们先讨论热，再讨论花。

examples.sentence: The council discussed bees for three minutes.
examples.trans: 议会讨论蜜蜂三分钟。

examples.sentence: What is not discussed at noon will be discussed in the hospital.
examples.trans: 中午不讨论的，会在医院讨论。

examples.sentence: She discussed the shortage without blaming the river.
examples.trans: 她讨论短缺，却不责备河。

examples.sentence: A discussion that cannot name trucks will not name air.
examples.trans: 无法点名卡车的讨论，也点不了名空气。

pollution.usageZh: 不可数名词：污染 air/water pollution。动词 pollute；形容词 polluted。

examples.sentence: Smoke is a kind of pollution.
examples.trans: 烟是一种污染。

examples.sentence: River pollution killed the evening swim.
examples.trans: 河流污染杀死了傍晚游泳。

examples.sentence: Air pollution sat in the kitchen like an unpaid guest.
examples.trans: 空气污染像不付钱的客人坐在厨房。

examples.sentence: They measured pollution in coughs, not only in stations.
examples.trans: 他们用咳嗽而不只是监测站来测量污染。

examples.sentence: Pollution delayed is still breathed.
examples.trans: 被推迟的污染仍被呼吸。

examples.sentence: A global market can export pollution and import praise.
examples.trans: 全球市场能出口污染，进口赞美。

shortage.usageZh: 可数名词：短缺 a water shortage。动词 short（be short of）。

examples.sentence: There is a shortage of shade.
examples.trans: 树荫短缺。

examples.sentence: The town faced a water shortage in August.
examples.trans: 八月镇子面临缺水。

examples.sentence: A shortage of bins is a surplus of litter.
examples.trans: 桶的短缺就是垃圾的过剩。

examples.sentence: Bee shortage is a food shortage with wings.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂短缺是带翅膀的食物短缺。

examples.sentence: They hid the shortage behind a fountain that did not drink.
examples.trans: 他们把短缺藏在一座不喝水的喷泉后面。

examples.sentence: Shortages predicted and ignored become shortages billed to children.
examples.trans: 被预测又被忽视的短缺，会变成开给孩子的账单。

overcome.usageZh: 动词：克服 overcome a shortage/fear。过去 overcame，过分 overcome。

examples.sentence: We can overcome the smell with a lid.
examples.trans: 我们可以用盖子克服气味。

examples.sentence: They overcame the shortage by sharing tanks.
examples.trans: 他们用共享水箱克服了短缺。

examples.sentence: Heat is not overcome by posters.
examples.trans: 热不是海报能克服的。

examples.sentence: To overcome pollution you name the truck, not the cough.
examples.trans: 要克服污染，要点名卡车，而不是咳嗽。

examples.sentence: The farm overcame a bad year because neighbours still had bees.
examples.trans: 农场熬过坏年，因为邻居仍有蜜蜂。

examples.sentence: What cannot be overcome by willpower is often a missing tree.
examples.trans: 意志克服不了的，往往是少了一棵树。

unfortunately.usageZh: 副词：不幸地。形容词 unfortunate；名词 fortune。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, the tap was dry.
examples.trans: 不幸的是，水龙头是干的。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately the truck mixed the sorted waste.
examples.trans: 不幸的是卡车把分好的废物混了。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately the shade was cut for a view.
examples.trans: 不幸的是树荫为了视野被砍了。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately is a word cities use when they already knew.
examples.trans: “不幸”是城市在早已知道时用的词。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately the bees did not read the global promise.
examples.trans: 不幸的是蜜蜂没读那份全球承诺。

examples.sentence: Unfortunately delayed repairs are a policy, not weather.
examples.trans: 不幸被推迟的修理是政策，不是天气。

attention.usageZh: 不可数名词：注意 pay/attract/draw attention to。形容词 attentive。

examples.sentence: Pay attention to the wet floor.
examples.trans: 注意湿地板。

examples.sentence: The river needs more attention than the fountain.
examples.trans: 河比喷泉更需要注意。

examples.sentence: Heat draws attention only after hospitals fill.
examples.trans: 热只有在医院填满后才引起注意。

examples.sentence: They paid attention to species that photograph well.
examples.trans: 他们注意上镜的物种。

examples.sentence: Public attention is a weather that moves before trucks do.
examples.trans: 公众注意力是一种比卡车先移动的天气。

examples.sentence: Attention without a budget is a camera.
examples.trans: 没有预算的注意是一台相机。

declined.usageZh: decline 的过去式：下降；婉拒。名词 decline。

examples.sentence: Bee numbers declined.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂数量下降了。

examples.sentence: She declined the plastic bag.
examples.trans: 她拒绝了塑料袋。

examples.sentence: Shade declined after the new car park.
examples.trans: 新停车场之后树荫下降了。

examples.sentence: A declined river is a declined table.
examples.trans: 下降的河就是下降的餐桌。

examples.sentence: They declined to call the shortage a mystery.
examples.trans: 他们拒绝把短缺称为谜。

examples.sentence: Declined species do not wait for the next slide.
examples.trans: 下降的物种不等下一张幻灯片。

irreplaceable.usageZh: 形容词：不可替代的。动词 replace；形容词 replaceable。

examples.sentence: Grandma's tree is irreplaceable.
examples.trans: 奶奶的树不可替代。

examples.sentence: Bees are irreplaceable workers.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂是不可替代的工人。

examples.sentence: An irreplaceable wetland was replaced with a slogan.
examples.trans: 一片不可替代的湿地被一句口号替换了。

examples.sentence: Shade grown over forty years is irreplaceable next summer.
examples.trans: 长了四十年的树荫，下一个夏天不可替代。

examples.sentence: They treated river mud as irreplaceable after it was gone.
examples.trans: 泥沼消失后，他们才把它当作不可替代。

examples.sentence: What is irreplaceable rarely fits a compensation form.
examples.trans: 不可替代的东西很少装得进补偿表。

vital.usageZh: 形容词：至关重要的 be vital to/for。副词 vitally。近义 essential。

examples.sentence: Water is vital.
examples.trans: 水至关重要。

examples.sentence: Bees are vital to fruit.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂对水果至关重要。

examples.sentence: Night cool air is vital in a concrete street.
examples.trans: 水泥街上夜间凉风至关重要。

examples.sentence: A vital wetland was mapped as empty land.
examples.trans: 至关重要的湿地被画成空地。

examples.sentence: It is vital that bins arrive before speeches.
examples.trans: 桶必须在演说之前到达。

examples.sentence: Vital systems are the ones posters forget because they still work.
examples.trans: 至关重要的系统是海报忘掉的那些，因为它们还在运转。

essential.usageZh: 形容词：必要的 essential to/for。名词 essence。

examples.sentence: Clean air is essential.
examples.trans: 清洁空气是必要的。

examples.sentence: Shade is essential at noon.
examples.trans: 中午树荫是必要的。

examples.sentence: Essential repairs waited while fountains were lit.
examples.trans: 必要修理在喷泉点亮时等候。

examples.sentence: It is essential to separate batteries.
examples.trans: 把电池分开是必要的。

examples.sentence: Essential workers of the insect world do not get speeches.
examples.trans: 昆虫世界的必要工人没有演说。

examples.sentence: What is essential in a heat wave is unfashionable in a brochure.
examples.trans: 热浪中必要的东西，在手册里不时髦。

reproduce.usageZh: 动词：繁殖；复制 reproduce a species / a sound。名词 reproduction。

examples.sentence: Fish reproduce in clean water.
examples.trans: 鱼在干净水里繁殖。

examples.sentence: Bees cannot reproduce well in this heat.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂在这种热里繁殖不好。

examples.sentence: The lab reproduced the storm on a small table.
examples.trans: 实验室在小桌上复制了风暴。

examples.sentence: A species that cannot reproduce is already a memory.
examples.trans: 无法繁殖的物种已是记忆。

examples.sentence: Cities reproduce cars faster than trees.
examples.trans: 城市复制汽车比复制树快。

examples.sentence: To reproduce a forest you need years, not a ribbon.
examples.trans: 要再造森林需要年，不是一条彩带。

rare.usageZh: 形容词：稀有的 a rare bird。副词 rarely；名词 rarity。

examples.sentence: This flower is rare here.
examples.trans: 这花在这里很少见。

examples.sentence: Clean rivers are becoming rare.
examples.trans: 干净的河越来越稀有。

examples.sentence: A rare cool night felt like a gift.
examples.trans: 一个稀有的凉夜像礼物。

examples.sentence: Rare species still need common flowers.
examples.trans: 稀有物种仍需要常见的花。

examples.sentence: They treated shade as rare after cutting it.
examples.trans: 砍了树荫后，他们才把它当稀有。

examples.sentence: Rarity in a brochure is often yesterday's ordinary street.
examples.trans: 手册里的稀有，往往是昨天普通的街道。

currently.usageZh: 副词：目前。形容词 current；名词 current 潮流/电流。

examples.sentence: The tap is currently dry.
examples.trans: 水龙头目前是干的。

examples.sentence: Bees are currently fewer at dawn.
examples.trans: 黎明时蜜蜂目前更少。

examples.sentence: Currently the truck still mixes sorted waste.
examples.trans: 目前卡车仍混合已分类废物。

examples.sentence: What is currently cheap may be currently stealing shade.
examples.trans: 目前便宜的，可能正在偷树荫。

examples.sentence: The plant is currently closed and currently leaking.
examples.trans: 工厂目前关闭，目前仍在漏。

examples.sentence: Currently is the tense of promises that have not met a bin.
examples.trans: “目前”是还没遇见桶的承诺的时态。

intensity.usageZh: 不可数名词：强度 heat intensity。形容词 intense；副词 intensely。

examples.sentence: The sun's intensity hurt the eyes.
examples.trans: 太阳的强度刺眼。

examples.sentence: Storm intensity rose year to year.
examples.trans: 风暴强度年复一年上升。

examples.sentence: The intensity of heat at noon emptied the square.
examples.trans: 中午热的强度掏空了广场。

examples.sentence: They measured intensity in hospital beds.
examples.trans: 他们用病床测量强度。

examples.sentence: Light intensity without trees is a kind of violence.
examples.trans: 没有树的光强是一种暴力。

examples.sentence: Intensity that was predicted is not a surprise; it is a bill.
examples.trans: 被预测过的强度不是意外，是账单。

predicted.usageZh: predict 的过去式/过分：预测。名词 prediction；形容词 predictable。

examples.sentence: Rain was predicted after lunch.
examples.trans: 预报午饭后有雨。

examples.sentence: They predicted a bee decline and cut flowers anyway.
examples.trans: 他们预测了蜜蜂下降，仍剪了花。

examples.sentence: The heat was predicted; the missing bins were not in the model.
examples.trans: 热被预测了；缺失的桶不在模型里。

examples.sentence: A predicted flood still needs an unpredicted truck.
examples.trans: 被预测的洪水仍需要一辆未被预测的卡车。

examples.sentence: She predicted that shade would become a luxury.
examples.trans: 她预测树荫会变成奢侈品。

examples.sentence: Predicted shortages ignored by budgets arrive on time.
examples.trans: 被预算忽视的预测短缺会准时到达。

prove.usageZh: 动词：证明 prove that / prove sb right。过去 proved，过分 proved/proven。

examples.sentence: This map proves the river was wider.
examples.trans: 这地图证明河曾经更宽。

examples.sentence: The empty dawn proved the prediction.
examples.trans: 空荡的黎明证明了预测。

examples.sentence: They could not prove the leak with a slogan.
examples.trans: 他们无法用口号证明泄漏。

examples.sentence: Bees proved more irreplaceable than the new car park.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂被证明比新停车场更不可替代。

examples.sentence: Time proved the cheap plastic expensive.
examples.trans: 时间证明便宜塑料很贵。

examples.sentence: What you cannot prove in a lab you can still prove in a cough.
examples.trans: 实验室证明不了的，仍能在咳嗽里证明。

trends.usageZh: 可数名词复数：趋势。单数 trend。动词 trend；形容词 trendy。

examples.sentence: Hot summers are a trend.
examples.trans: 炎热夏天是一种趋势。

examples.sentence: Waste trends follow cheap shelves.
examples.trans: 废物趋势跟着便宜货架走。

examples.sentence: The trend toward fewer birds is not a fashion.
examples.trans: 鸟变少的趋势不是时尚。

examples.sentence: They sold climate trends as jacket colours.
examples.trans: 他们把气候趋势当外套颜色卖。

examples.sentence: Local trends in coughs matched global graphs.
examples.trans: 本地咳嗽趋势与全球图表吻合。

examples.sentence: A trend predicted and funded against is no longer fate.
examples.trans: 被预测并被拨款对抗的趋势，不再是命运。

formation.usageZh: 名词：形成 cloud/habit formation。动词 form。

examples.sentence: Cloud formation comes before rain.
examples.trans: 云的形成在雨之前。

examples.sentence: The formation of litter follows missing bins.
examples.trans: 垃圾的形成跟着缺失的桶。

examples.sentence: Habit formation around reuse needs a sink that works.
examples.trans: 再用习惯的形成需要能用的水槽。

examples.sentence: Storm formation over warm water was predicted.
examples.trans: 暖水上的风暴形成被预测了。

examples.sentence: The formation of a dump next to the school was a choice.
examples.trans: 学校旁边垃圾场的形成是一种选择。

examples.sentence: Soil formation takes years that budgets do not have.
examples.trans: 土壤形成需要预算没有的年。

renewable.usageZh: 形容词：可再生的 renewable energy。动词 renew；反义 non-renewable。

examples.sentence: Wind is renewable.
examples.trans: 风能是可再生的。

examples.sentence: They want renewable power for the pumps.
examples.trans: 他们希望水泵用可再生能源。

examples.sentence: Renewable energy that cuts a forest is a quarrel of names.
examples.trans: 砍森林的可再生能源是名称之争。

examples.sentence: A renewable city renews shade, not only cables.
examples.trans: 可再生的城市更新树荫，而不只是电缆。

examples.sentence: The contract called the dump renewable because trucks came daily.
examples.trans: 合同称垃圾场可再生，因为卡车天天来。

examples.sentence: Renewable promises still need non-renewable attention to bins.
examples.trans: 可再生的承诺仍需要对桶付出不可再生的注意。

examples.sentence: Litter is an environmental problem.
examples.trans: 乱扔是环境问题。

examples.sentence: Heat is becoming an environmental problem in kitchens.
examples.trans: 热正在变成厨房里的环境问题。

examples.sentence: Environmental problems hide in 'other' bins.
examples.trans: 环境问题藏在“其他”桶里。

examples.sentence: They named environmental problems after the truck, not the cough.
examples.trans: 他们用卡车而不是咳嗽来给环境问题命名。

examples.sentence: Small environmental problems ignored become hospital graphs.
examples.trans: 被忽视的小环境问题会变成医院图表。

examples.sentence: Environmental problems sold as lifestyle will not meet a budget.
examples.trans: 当生活方式出售的环境问题遇不上预算。

examples.sentence: Global warming is in the news.
examples.trans: 全球变暖出现在新闻里。

examples.sentence: Global warming sat on the bus without shade.
examples.trans: 全球变暖坐在没有树荫的公交上。

examples.sentence: Global warming is local when the night stays hot.
examples.trans: 夜里仍然热时，全球变暖是本地的。

examples.sentence: They felt global warming as fewer bees at dawn.
examples.trans: 他们把全球变暖感受成黎明蜜蜂更少。

examples.sentence: A fountain will not cancel global warming.
examples.trans: 喷泉取消不了全球变暖。

examples.sentence: Global warming delayed in speeches still arrives in harvests.
examples.trans: 演说里被推迟的全球变暖，仍会在收获里到达。

examples.sentence: Glass starts as raw materials.
examples.trans: 玻璃从原材料开始。

examples.sentence: Raw materials leave holes in far hills.
examples.trans: 原材料在远处的山上留下洞。

examples.sentence: Cheap raw materials are often expensive rivers.
examples.trans: 便宜原材料常常是昂贵的河。

examples.sentence: They traced raw materials to a village without shade.
examples.trans: 他们把原材料追溯到没有树荫的村子。

examples.sentence: A bottle forgets its raw materials; the hill does not.
examples.trans: 瓶子忘记原材料；山不会。

examples.sentence: Markets that hide raw materials will hide their damage.
examples.trans: 藏起原材料的市场也会藏起损害。

examples.sentence: Put recyclable waste here.
examples.trans: 把可回收废物放这里。

examples.sentence: Recyclable waste still needs a buyer.
examples.trans: 可回收废物仍需要买家。

examples.sentence: If recyclable waste is mixed, it becomes ordinary waste.
examples.trans: 可回收废物一混合，就变成普通废物。

examples.sentence: They sorted recyclable waste and watched the truck mix it.
examples.trans: 他们分好可回收废物，看着卡车把它混合。

examples.sentence: Recyclable waste without a factory is a hopeful pile.
examples.trans: 没有工厂的可回收废物是一堆希望。

examples.sentence: A city of recyclable waste still needs less waste.
examples.trans: 可回收废物之城仍需要更少废物。

food waste.usageZh: 名词短语：食物浪费/厨余。

examples.sentence: Do not make food waste.
examples.trans: 不要制造厨余浪费。

examples.sentence: Food waste can become soil.
examples.trans: 厨余可以变成土壤。

examples.sentence: Markets throw food waste while kitchens lack rice.
examples.trans: 市场扔掉厨余，厨房却缺米。

examples.sentence: They collected food waste for the community garden.
examples.trans: 他们收集厨余给社区菜园。

examples.sentence: Food waste is a timetable error as much as a moral one.
examples.trans: 厨余既是时间表错误，也是道德错误。

examples.sentence: A policy on food waste that ignores hungry shifts will fail.
examples.trans: 忽视饥饿班次的厨余政策会失败。

examples.sentence: Keep harmful waste out of the river.
examples.trans: 别让有害废物进河。

examples.sentence: Batteries are harmful waste.
examples.trans: 电池是有害废物。

examples.sentence: Harmful waste was stored behind the school.
examples.trans: 有害废物存在学校后面。

examples.sentence: They labelled harmful waste after the fire, not before.
examples.trans: 火灾之后他们才给有害废物贴标签。

examples.sentence: Harmful waste travels farther than the factory's name.
examples.trans: 有害废物比工厂的名字走得更远。

examples.sentence: A global shelf can hide harmful waste in a local ditch.
examples.trans: 全球货架能把有害废物藏进本地沟里。

examples.sentence: Use the recycle bin for paper.
examples.trans: 纸用回收桶。

examples.sentence: The recycle bin overflowed after the festival.
examples.trans: 节庆后回收桶溢了。

examples.sentence: A recycle bin in the sun smells like a dare.
examples.trans: 太阳下的回收桶气味像挑衅。

examples.sentence: They painted the recycle bin and forgot the truck.
examples.trans: 他们给回收桶刷了漆，忘了卡车。

examples.sentence: Night streets need a recycle bin too.
examples.trans: 夜街也需要回收桶。

examples.sentence: A pretty recycle bin without a route is sculpture.
examples.trans: 没有路线的漂亮回收桶是雕塑。

examples.sentence: Rain is a matter of time.
examples.trans: 下雨只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: Without bins, litter is a matter of time.
examples.trans: 没有桶，乱扔只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: Bee decline was a matter of time after the flowers were cut.
examples.trans: 花被剪后，蜜蜂下降只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: Heat in the square is a matter of time once shade is sold.
examples.trans: 树荫被卖掉后，广场的热只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: They called the flood a surprise; it was a matter of time.
examples.trans: 他们称洪水为意外；那只是时间问题。

examples.sentence: A predicted shortage becomes a matter of time when budgets blink.
examples.trans: 预算一眨眼，被预测的短缺就只是时间问题。

save a lot of lives.usageZh: 动词短语：拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: Shade can save a lot of lives.
examples.trans: 树荫能拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: Clean water saved a lot of lives in the heat.
examples.trans: 清洁的水在炎热中拯救了许多生命。

examples.sentence: Early warnings save a lot of lives if someone can leave.
examples.trans: 如果有人能离开，预警能拯救许多生命。

examples.sentence: Bins will not save a lot of lives; hospitals still might, if funded.
examples.trans: 桶不会拯救许多生命；医院仍可能，如果有钱。

examples.sentence: They said trees would save a lot of lives and then paved the roots.
examples.trans: 他们说树会拯救许多生命，然后铺掉了根。

examples.sentence: Policies that save a lot of lives rarely look magnificent at noon.
examples.trans: 拯救许多生命的政策，中午很少看起来壮丽。

examples.sentence: Start with simple steps: a lid on the bin.
examples.trans: 从简单步骤开始：给桶加盖。

examples.sentence: Simple steps like turning off lamps still need habits.
examples.trans: 关灯这类简单步骤仍需要习惯。

examples.sentence: They posted simple steps and skipped the truck.
examples.trans: 他们张贴简单步骤，跳过了卡车。

examples.sentence: Simple steps fail when washing them is unpaid.
examples.trans: 清洗无人付酬时，简单步骤会失败。

examples.sentence: The brochure's simple steps forgot batteries.
examples.trans: 手册的简单步骤忘了电池。

examples.sentence: Simple steps are not the opposite of funded systems.
examples.trans: 简单步骤不是资助系统的反面。

examples.sentence: Birds return from year to year.
examples.trans: 鸟年复一年回来。

examples.sentence: Heat rises from year to year in the square.
examples.trans: 广场的热年复一年上升。

examples.sentence: From year to year the river ran thinner.
examples.trans: 河水年复一年更瘦。

examples.sentence: They measured bees from year to year at the same dawn.
examples.trans: 他们在同一个黎明年复一年测量蜜蜂。

examples.sentence: Promises repeated from year to year without bins are songs.
examples.trans: 年复一年重复、没有桶的承诺是歌。

examples.sentence: From year to year predicted storms stopped being news.
examples.trans: 年复一年，被预测的风暴不再是新闻。

make sense.usageZh: 动词短语：有道理 make sense of sth。

examples.sentence: This map does not make sense.
examples.trans: 这地图讲不通。

examples.sentence: Sorting waste makes sense if the truck agrees.
examples.trans: 如果卡车同意，分类才有道理。

examples.sentence: Heat without shade does not make sense as a festival.
examples.trans: 没有树荫的热作为节庆讲不通。

examples.sentence: They could not make sense of a fountain next to a dry tap.
examples.trans: 他们无法理解干水龙头旁边的喷泉。

examples.sentence: A slogan makes sense only next to a budget line.
examples.trans: 口号只有在预算行旁边才有道理。

examples.sentence: It makes sense to plant trees where people wait.
examples.trans: 在人们等候的地方种树是有道理的。

stand as one.usageZh: 动词短语：团结一致 stand as one (against/with)。

examples.sentence: Neighbours stand as one after storms.
examples.trans: 风暴后邻居团结一致。

examples.sentence: The street stood as one for the missing bins.
examples.trans: 这条街为缺失的桶团结一致。

examples.sentence: Farms and bees stand as one, whether posters say so or not.
examples.trans: 农场和蜜蜂团结一致，无论海报怎么说。

examples.sentence: They could not stand as one while the truck mixed the waste.
examples.trans: 卡车混合废物时，他们无法团结。

examples.sentence: To stand as one against heat you share shade, not hashtags.
examples.trans: 要团结抗热，就分享树荫，而不是话题标签。

examples.sentence: Cities that will not stand as one with their poorest streets will bake together anyway.
examples.trans: 不愿与最穷街道团结的城市，仍会一起被烤。

play a role in.usageZh: 动词短语：起作用 play a role in sth。

examples.sentence: Bees play a role in fruit.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂在水果里起作用。

examples.sentence: Bins play a role in clean rivers.
examples.trans: 桶在清洁的河里起作用。

examples.sentence: Shade plays a role in whether a square is kind.
examples.trans: 树荫决定广场是否友善。

examples.sentence: Night trucks play a role in coughs the clinic cannot name.
examples.trans: 夜班卡车在诊所叫不出名的咳嗽里起作用。

examples.sentence: Children play a role in reminding adults where the tap was.
examples.trans: 孩子提醒大人水龙头曾在哪。

examples.sentence: Budgets play a role in every so-called natural disaster.
examples.trans: 预算在每一场所谓自然灾害里起作用。

depend on.usageZh: 短语动词：依靠 depend on sb/sth。形容词 dependent。

examples.sentence: Farms depend on bees.
examples.trans: 农场依靠蜜蜂。

examples.sentence: The trees depend on night cool air.
examples.trans: 树依靠夜间凉风。

examples.sentence: A recycle bin depends on a truck that does not mix.
examples.trans: 回收桶依靠一辆不混合的卡车。

examples.sentence: They depend on a river the factory also depends on.
examples.trans: 他们和工厂依靠同一条河。

examples.sentence: Hospitals depend on shade they did not plant.
examples.trans: 医院依靠他们没有种的树荫。

examples.sentence: A city that depends on cheap plastic depends on a future bill.
examples.trans: 依靠便宜塑料的城市，依靠一张未来账单。

work on.usageZh: 短语动词：致力于 work on a problem/plan。

examples.sentence: They work on the leak.
examples.trans: 他们在处理泄漏。

examples.sentence: She works on a map of missing bins.
examples.trans: 她在做缺失桶的地图。

examples.sentence: The lab works on heat that kitchens already know.
examples.trans: 实验室研究厨房已经知道的热。

examples.sentence: Work on bees, not only on honey labels.
examples.trans: 研究蜜蜂，而不只是蜂蜜标签。

examples.sentence: They worked on predictions and underworked on trucks.
examples.trans: 他们致力于预测，对卡车用力不够。

examples.sentence: To work on the environment is to work on whose hours get shade.
examples.trans: 致力于环境，就是致力于谁的钟点能有树荫。

stronger than ever.usageZh: 比较短语：比以往任何时候都更强。

examples.sentence: The smell is stronger than ever.
examples.trans: 气味比以往任何时候都强。

examples.sentence: Storms are stronger than ever this decade.
examples.trans: 这十年风暴比以往更强。

examples.sentence: Public anger is stronger than ever after the mixed truck.
examples.trans: 卡车混合之后，公愤前所未有地强。

examples.sentence: The heat at noon is stronger than ever in the new square.
examples.trans: 新广场中午的热前所未有。

examples.sentence: Bees need flowers stronger than ever, and find fewer.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂比以往任何时候都更需要花，却找到更少。

examples.sentence: A promise stronger than ever on paper can be weaker than ever in the river.
examples.trans: 纸上前所未有地强的承诺，在河里可以前所未有地弱。

lead to.usageZh: 短语动词：导致 lead to sth。过去 led to。

examples.sentence: Heat can lead to illness.
examples.trans: 热可能导致疾病。

examples.sentence: Missing bins lead to litter.
examples.trans: 缺失的桶导致乱扔。

examples.sentence: Cutting shade led to a hotter bus stop.
examples.trans: 砍树荫导致公交站更热。

examples.sentence: Cheap plastic leads to a far hill with a hole.
examples.trans: 便宜塑料通向一座有洞的远山。

examples.sentence: The mixed truck led to a fire in the 'other' pile.
examples.trans: 混合的卡车导致“其他”堆起火。

examples.sentence: Slogans that do not lead to trucks lead to hospitals.
examples.trans: 带不出卡车的口号会通向医院。

get rid of.usageZh: 短语动词：去除 get rid of waste/smoke。

examples.sentence: Get rid of the dripping first.
examples.trans: 先去掉滴水。

examples.sentence: They got rid of plastic bags at the market.
examples.trans: 他们在市场去掉了塑料袋。

examples.sentence: You cannot get rid of heat with a fountain.
examples.trans: 用喷泉去不掉热。

examples.sentence: Get rid of the joke that bees are optional.
examples.trans: 去掉蜜蜂可有可无的笑话。

examples.sentence: The factory got rid of the smell by moving the pipe.
examples.trans: 工厂把管子挪走，去掉了气味。

examples.sentence: Cities try to get rid of 'ugly' wetlands and then buy floods.
examples.trans: 城市想去掉“难看的”湿地，然后去买洪水。

move toward.usageZh: 短语动词：朝……前进 move toward(s) a goal。

examples.sentence: We move toward the shade.
examples.trans: 我们朝树荫走。

examples.sentence: The city moved toward reusable trays.
examples.trans: 城市朝可再用托盘前进。

examples.sentence: Policy moved toward predicted storms and then stopped at the slide.
examples.trans: 政策朝被预测的风暴前进，然后停在幻灯片上。

examples.sentence: Bees move toward flowers, not toward slogans.
examples.trans: 蜜蜂朝花前进，不朝口号。

examples.sentence: To move toward less waste, fund washing, not only posters.
examples.trans: 要朝更少废物前进，就资助清洗，而不只是海报。

examples.sentence: A budget that will not move toward bins will move toward hospitals.
examples.trans: 不愿朝桶前进的预算，会朝医院前进。

grammar.title: 真实条件句（第一类）
grammar.usage: 第一类条件句谈真实可能的将来：If + 一般现在时, 主句 will / be going to / 情态 / 祈使。肯定：If you stay keen, you will improve. 否定：If you don't practise, it isn't going to happen。If 从句不用 will。unless = if ... not。as long as / provided that 也可引导真实条件。初中：时态搭配。高中：should you need（倒装）、祈使+and/or。
forms: If + 现在时, 主语 + will / be going to + 原形
If + 现在时, 祈使句（If you see her, tell her.）
Unless + 现在时, 主句（= if ... not）
If + 现在时, 情态 can/may/must/should
祈使句 + and / or + 将来结果
Should + 主语 + 原形, 主句 will（书面倒装）
notes: If 从句用现在时表将来，避免 if it will rain。
unless 本身含否定，不再加 don't：unless you hurry，不是 unless you don't hurry（除非有意双重否定）。
be going to 强调基于现状的后果。
主句可以是祈使：If the oil smokes, turn the heat down.
provided that / as long as 强调“唯一需要满足的条件”。

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay inside.
examples.cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。

examples.en: If you miss this bus, take the next one.
examples.cn: 如果错过这班车，坐下一班。

examples.en: Unless you lock the gate, the goats will leave.
examples.cn: 除非你锁上门，山羊会跑掉。

examples.en: If the river rises, the sheds can flood overnight.
examples.cn: 河水一涨，棚子可能一夜被淹。

examples.en: Bring a torch and you will see the path.
examples.cn: 带上手电，你就能看见路。

examples.en: Should the ferry cancel, the village will open the hall.
examples.cn: 万一轮渡取消，村子会开放礼堂。

exercises.q: If it ____, we will stay inside.
If you run, you ____ catch the bus.
____ you are late, call me.
选择正确句子。
options: If she is free, she will come.
If she will be free, she comes.
If she free, she will come.
If she is free, she coming.
exercises.answer: If she is free, she will come.

exercises.q: If the soup is hot, ____ it slowly.
If Tom ____ (finish) early, he will help us.
If you don't hurry, you ____ miss the start.
If the light is red, ____ (stop).
If 从句里要用 will 表示将来。
“If you see him, tell him.” 是正确的。
用 if 连接：It rains. We stay inside. → If it rains, we ____ inside.
改成否定条件：If you hurry, you will catch it. → If you ____ hurry, you will miss it.
改成祈使主句：If the milk boils, you will turn it down. → If the milk boils, ____ it down.
改错：If it will rain, we stay.
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will stay.

exercises.q: 改错：If she have time, she will come.
exercises.answer: If she has time, she will come.

exercises.q: Unless you ____ the gate, the goats will leave.
If he doesn't practise, it ____ going to happen.
Take a map ____ you will get lost.
If the ice looks thin, you ____ stay off it.
____ you finish, we can leave.
Unless it ____ (stop) raining, we will wait.
Bring a coat ____ you will feel cold.
If they are hungry, they ____ (can / eat) first.
unless 相当于 if ... not。
“Unless you don't lock it” 是最自然的说法。
exercises.explain: 双重否定别扭，用 If you don't lock 或 Unless you lock。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't water it, it will die. → Unless you ____ it, it will die.
用 and 连接：Hurry up. You will catch it. → Hurry up ____ you will catch it.
If she ____ (not be) careful, she will drop it.
改错：Unless you will hurry, you miss it.
exercises.answer: Unless you hurry, you will miss it.

exercises.q: 改错：If you will see her, tell her.
exercises.answer: If you see her, tell her.

exercises.q: As long as the radio ____, we can ask for a boat.
If the river rises tonight, the sheds ____ flood.
Provided that you ____ a torch, the path is safe.
Should you need help, you ____ ring the bell.
If you can't stay keen, it is never ____ happen.
If the oil smokes, ____ the heat down.
You will not improve unless you ____ (stay) keen.
Should the lights fail, we ____ use the stairs.
第一类条件可以在主句用 be going to。
provided that 引导的从句要用 will。
用 as long as 改写：If you have internet, there are resources. → As long as you ____ internet, there are resources.
用 unless 改写：If you don't stay keen, it will not happen. → Unless you ____ keen, it will not happen.
Should 倒装：If you need water, call us. → Should you ____ water, call us.
改错：If you will not stay keen, it never happens.
exercises.answer: If you don't stay keen, it is never going to happen. / If you don't stay keen, it will never happen.

exercises.q: 改错：Provided that you will bring a torch, we go.
exercises.answer: Provided that you bring a torch, we will go.

exercises.q: If the sensors are not calibrated, the dashboard ____ elegant lies.
Unless inspectors ____ on Monday, the clause is paper.
Should the cable fail, the city ____ go dark.
Give them the raw files ____ trust will follow.
If a family cannot afford private lessons, distance education ____ still help.
If wages freeze, rents ____ still climb.
The plan works provided that both farms ____ (sign).
Fail to name the spill ____ you will lose the room.
exercises.explain: 祈使含义 + and。实际是祈使句 Fail...

exercises.q: Should + 主语 + 原形 可以替代 if 真实条件，语气更书面。
第一类条件主句不能使用 can 或 may。
用 unless 改写：If the board does not see the numbers, it will not sign. → Unless the board ____ the numbers, it will not sign.
倒装：If you need the archive, write ahead. → Should you ____ the archive, write ahead.
用 going to 强调后果：If you hide the leak, it ____ get worse.
改错：If the river will rise, the sheds flood.
exercises.answer: If the river rises, the sheds will flood.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless they will arrive, wait.
If access is sold as privilege, knowledge ____ like a gated park.
The talks will stall unless both river maps ____ on one table.
Should night deliveries continue, the street ____ not sleep.
Calibrate the sensors ____ the dashboard will stop lying.
If the intern answers without checking, the client ____ still quote the number.
If shade is treated as decoration, summers ____ punish walkers.
You may publish provided that the raw files ____ (be) posted.
Ignore the quieter villages ____ the map will lie.
provided that 与 as long as 都可以引导充分条件。
真实条件的倒装必须用 Had + 过去分词。
exercises.explain: 那是对过去的虚拟；真实将来用 Should + 原形。

exercises.q: 用 should 倒装：If the audit finds gaps, pause. → Should the audit ____ gaps, pause.
用 unless 改写：If we do not post raw files, trust will thin. → Unless we ____ raw files, trust will thin.
祈使 + or：Name the spill. You will lose the room. → Name the spill ____ you will lose the room.
改错：If inspectors will arrive, the treaty lives.
exercises.answer: If inspectors arrive, the treaty will live. / If inspectors arrive, the treaty lives as a general truth.

exercises.q: 改错：Should the cable failed, the city goes dark.
exercises.answer: Should the cable fail, the city will go dark.

exercises.q: If a society cannot fund that care, it ____ pay later in harsher rooms.
The model will bankrupt the plan unless demand ____ recalibrated.
Should incentives and enforcement fail to move together, campaigns ____.
Publish the files ____ accusations of elegance-without-evidence will fade.
If the footnote stays buried, a reader ____ be forgiven for missing it.
If we mistake spill for peace, the next decade ____ collect the bill.
The clause holds provided that inspectors ____ (have) real access.
Fail to translate assumptions ____ you will only swap terms.
第一类条件可以描述制度性的真实后果，不必谈个人日程。
exercises.explain: 语法管的是可能性，不是话题。

exercises.q: Unless 从句在书面语里必须倒装。
倒装：If the treaty lacks inspectors, it remains paper. → Should the treaty ____ inspectors, it will remain paper.
unless 被动：If the sensors are not calibrated, the dashboard lies. → Unless the sensors ____, the dashboard will lie.
用 going to 强调已有迹象：The river is already high; if it rains, the sheds ____ flood.
改错：If access will be sold as privilege, knowledge looks gated.
exercises.answer: If access is sold as privilege, knowledge will look gated.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless demand will be recalibrated, the model bankrupts the plan.
exercises.answer: Unless demand is recalibrated, the model will bankrupt the plan.

grammar.title: 现在完成时
grammar.usage: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词，连接过去与现在。They have gone through a hard year。标志词 already/yet/just/ever/never/for/since。对比一般过去：有具体过去时间用过去时。高中：完成进行 have been doing；被动 have been done。
forms: for + 时段 / since + 起点
have/has been + 过去分词（被动）
notes: He has 不是 He have。
短暂动词不宜接 for：改用 been here。
yesterday 用过去时。
since 接起点，for 接时段。
疑问 Have you ever...？

examples.en: Nia has sorted the bottles.
examples.cn: 丽娜已经洗了杯子。

examples.en: They have gone through a noisy month.
examples.cn: 他们经历了嘈杂的一个月。

examples.en: He has not slept yet.
examples.cn: 他还没睡。

examples.en: The family has lived here since March.
examples.cn: 这家人从三月起住在这里。

examples.en: Night trucks have been ignored in the report.
examples.cn: 无偿时数在报告里一直被忽略。

examples.en: She has been waiting for the recycle truck since ten.
examples.cn: 她从十点起一直在等夜班车。

exercises.q: She ____ sorted the bottles.
I ____ finished dinner.
They have ____ the door.
选择正确句子。
We have not eaten ____.
Tom ____ (have) lost his key.
After she has ____ (eat), she will rest.
I have ____ (just / arrive).
现在完成由 have/has + 过去分词构成。
He have gone 正确。
碗是空的。她已经洗了。→ She ____ the bottles.
否定：They have started. → They have not started ____.
After he ____ (finish), he will sleep.
改错：She have sorted.
改错：He has go home.
They ____ through a hard month.
____ you ever waited for a recycle truck?
She has already ____ the apology.
We have lived here ____ 2019.
He has been tired ____ two weeks.
They have ____ (lock) the door.
I have not seen her ____ Monday.
____ you sorted yet?
since 接起点，for 接时段。
He has arrived for two hours 很自然。
经历：They went through a hard year, and it still shows. → They ____ a hard year.
since：她从早上就在等。She ____ since morning.
already：We sorted. → We have ____ sorted.
改错：They has gone through a hard month.
exercises.answer: They have gone through a hard month.

exercises.q: 改错：He has arrived for two hours.
exercises.answer: He has been here for two hours.

exercises.q: Many families have ____ spill that was called safety.
Once they have ____ an understanding, dumping drops.
She has never ____ a river bench.
____ having named the fear, they slept.
The statistics have ____ the riverbanks.
When the rain has ____ (stop), we will walk.
She has ____ (be) waiting all week.
After they have eaten, they ____ (talk).
after having done 是书面结构。
有 yesterday 仍必须用现在完成。
once：You name the fear. Then you rest. → Once you ____ the fear, rest.
完成进行：她一上午都在等公交。She ____ for the bus all morning.
after having：They cooked. Then they talked. → After ____, they talked.
改错：They have suffer from spill.
改错：The board has signed yesterday.
Night trucks have ____ in the report.
The family has not slept ____.
Inspectors have waited ____ dawn.
She has been ____ the recycle truck since ten.
Once the sorted bins have been ____, workers can actually rest.
After they have posted the hours, trust ____ (return).
The clause has ____ (remain) paper.
____ having sealed the door, they waited.
时间从句里的现在完成可指向将来已完成。
有明确过去时间仍必须用现在完成。
被动：They ignore mixed waste. It still shows. → Mixed waste ____ in the report.
完成进行：从十点起一直在等。She ____ since ten.
for/since：两周了。He has been tired ____ two weeks.
改错：Night trucks have ignored in the report.
exercises.answer: Night trucks have been ignored in the report.

exercises.q: 改错：They have gone through it last March.
exercises.answer: They went through it last March.

exercises.q: Night dumps have continued ____ two winters.
We have already ____ whose hours vanished.
Until the missing bus ____, spill stood still.
They have been ____ the spill rather than naming it.
After having ____ the totals, they published a neat page.
Once enforcement has ____ (move), slogans mean something.
The street has not slept ____ night dumps arrived.
They have been ____ (share) the heavy hours.
lie 的过去分词是 lain。
after having done 不能带宾语。
once 被动：They fund sorted bins. Then people rest. → Once sorted bins ____, people can rest.
after having：They hid the spill. Then they lost trust. → After ____ the spill, they lost trust.
for：夜班车两冬没停。Night dumps have continued ____ two winters.
改错：We have named the hours last March.
exercises.answer: We named the hours last March.

exercises.q: 改错：Night trucks have being ignored.
A city has ____ spill that it called safety.
Once access has been ____ as privilege, equality looks gated.
The footnote has ____ in the appendix for three drafts.
Inspectors have yet ____ real hours.
Having ____ the riverbanks, they found the statistic was a room.
Until night trucks have been ____ (count), posters will lie.
The treaty has remained paper since sorted bins ____ (be) denied.
She has been ____ (mistake) silence for peace.
have yet to do 表示尚未发生。
Having done 的逻辑主语须是主句主语。
have yet to：休息日仍未兑现。Workers ____ sorted bins.
exercises.answer: have yet to be given / have yet to receive

exercises.q: after 被动：Society defers care. Later it pays. → After care ____, it still pays later.
分词：They named the riverbanks. They saw the gap. → ____ the riverbanks, they saw the gap.
改错：The footnote has laid in the appendix.
exercises.answer: The footnote has lain in the appendix.

exercises.q: 改错：Having named the riverbanks, the statistic looked false. （悬垂）
exercises.answer: Having named the riverbanks, they found the statistic looked false.

grammar.title: 定语从句 which
grammar.usage: that 引导限制性定语从句，指人/物，作主语或宾语；作宾语可省。物也可用 which；人用 who/whom/that。介词后不用 that，用 which/whom。不定代词、最高级、the only 后多用 that。高中：that 不可引导非限制性（逗号后用 which/who）。
notes: that 前一般不加逗号。
介词后不用 that。
the only/first/最高级后常用 that。
that 不能放在非限制性从句。
whose 表所属。

examples.en: This is the key that opens the door.
examples.cn: 这是开门的那把钥匙。

examples.en: The neighbour that knocked brought soup.
examples.cn: 敲门的邻居带来了汤。

examples.en: The hours that nobody counted still happened.
examples.cn: 没人计算的那些时数仍然发生了。

examples.en: She is the only person that kept the night feed.
examples.cn: 她是唯一守夜喂奶的人。

examples.en: The bus, which left at four, never returned.
examples.cn: 四点离开的那班车再也没回来。

examples.en: A right that trips on a plant clock is still ink.
examples.cn: 会被厨房时钟绊倒的权利仍是墨水。

exercises.q: This is the key ____ opens the door.
The cup ____ I sorted is dry.
The girl ____ smiled is Nia.
选择正确句子。
options: The book that I like is short.
The book which that I like is short.
The book that I like it is short.
The book who I like is short.
exercises.answer: The book that I like is short.

exercises.q: This is the soup ____ Grandma made.
The bus ____ (that) we missed left. 填 that 或不填。
The man ____ (who) knocked is Kai.
I like the song that she ____ (sing).
that 引导的限制性从句前通常没有逗号。
定语从句里要重复 the book that I like it。
主语：开门的钥匙。→ the key ____ opens the door
宾语：我洗的杯子。→ the cup ____ I sorted
人：微笑的女孩。→ the girl ____ smiled
改错：The book that I like it is short.
exercises.answer: The book that I like is short.

exercises.q: 改错：The key who opens the door.
exercises.answer: The key that/which opens the door.

exercises.q: The neighbour ____ knocked brought soup.
This is the only chair ____ fits.
The night ____ we waited felt long. （时间用 when 更好）
The house in ____ they lived was small. （介词后）
She kept the promise that she ____.
He is the first person that ____ (arrive).
The street ____ (where) we walked was quiet.
The river maps that Kai ____ (do) shone.
介词后面不用 that。
the only/first/最高级后常用 that。
the only：唯一合适的椅子。→ the only chair ____ fits
介词：他们住的房子。→ the house in ____ they lived
where：我们走过的街。→ the street ____ we walked
改错：the house in that they lived
exercises.answer: the house in which they lived / the house that they lived in

exercises.q: 改错：the only chair which that fits
The hours that nobody ____ still happened.
She is the only person that ____ the night feed.
Families that ____ a river bench suffered more.
The joke, ____ was not kind, reopened the fight.
Anyone that ____ by noise is guessing.
All that ____ (glitter) is not gold. 谚语。
The long clean-ups, which ____ (steal) evenings, still echo.
Whose hours vanished is the question that ____ (matter).
非限制性从句用 which/who，不用 that。
不定代词后多用 that。
非限制：那个笑话不友善，重新打开了争吵。→ The joke, ____ was not kind, reopened the fight.
the only：唯一守夜的人。→ the only person ____ kept the night feed
all that：闪光的不都是金子。→ All that ____ is not gold.
改错：The joke, that was not kind, reopened the fight.
exercises.answer: The joke, which was not kind, reopened the fight.

exercises.q: 改错：Anyone which judges by noise is guessing.
exercises.answer: Anyone that/who judges by noise is guessing.

exercises.q: A right that ____ on a plant clock is still ink.
The bus of ____ they spoke never returned. （介词）
Mixed waste that riverbanks ____ vanish from posters.
The report, ____ flattened riverbanks, looked neat.
It is the last collection that ____ equality.
The hours for ____ nobody paid still happened. 用 which。
Those that ____ (carry) the house are rarely named.
A poster that ____ (praise) care without funding it lies.
介词 + which 不能换成介词 + that。
强调句 It is...that... 与定语从句形式相近但功能不同。
介词：他们说起的那班车。→ the bus of ____ they spoke
非限制：报告把厨房抹平，看起来整齐。→ The report, ____ flattened riverbanks, looked neat.
that 主语：会被时钟绊倒的权利。→ a right that ____ on a plant clock
改错：the bus of that they spoke
exercises.answer: the bus of which they spoke / the bus that they spoke of

exercises.q: 改错：The report, that flattened riverbanks, looked neat.
exercises.answer: The report, which flattened riverbanks, looked neat.

exercises.q: Villages that river maps ____ still need buses.
The winter in ____ night dumps ruled lasted long.
Slogans that ____ hours as love will fail the riverbank.
The average, ____ hid the riverbank, won a headline.
Little that ____ unpaid is called work.
The street on ____ trucks ran did not sleep. 用 which。
Nothing that ____ (cost) a woman hours is 'just helping'.
Rents that freeze wages ____ (reveal) a policy.
little/nothing/all 后常用 that。
in which 可与 when 互换，但介词必须匹配。
介词：夜班卡车统治的那个冬天。→ the winter in ____ night dumps ruled
nothing that：花费女性时数的事不是“帮忙”。→ Nothing that ____ a woman hours is 'just helping'.
非限制：平均数藏起水槽，赢了标题。→ The average, ____ hid the riverbank, won a headline.
改错：the winter in that night dumps ruled
exercises.answer: the winter in which night dumps ruled

exercises.q: 改错：Little which is unpaid is called work.
exercises.answer: Little that is unpaid is called work.

exercises.q: Contributions that GDP ____ still feed the city.
The decade during ____ spill passed as peace will invoice us.
Ink that cannot ____ a plant clock remains ink.
The waiting list, ____ shamed the depressed, grew longer.
All that a last collection ____ is a politics of hours.
The appendix in ____ footnotes drown is a policy. 用 which。
Anyone that ____ (sell) spill as safety should be named.
A right that ____ (trip) on a clock is a speech.
during which 比 when 更正式。
all that 后谓语跟 all 的意义，常用单数概念。
介词：延误被当作和平的十年。→ the decade during ____ spill passed as peace
all that：末班车检验的不过是钟点政治。→ All that a last collection ____ is a politics of hours.
非限制：等候名单羞辱抑郁者，还在变长。→ The waiting list, ____ shamed the depressed, grew longer.
改错：the decade during that spill passed as peace
exercises.answer: the decade during which spill passed as peace

exercises.q: 改错：The waiting list, that shamed the depressed, grew longer.
exercises.answer: The waiting list, which shamed the depressed, grew longer.

grammar.title: 越来越…
grammar.usage: 叠用比较级表单一趋势：noisier and noisier / more and more tired。对比 the more..., the more... 连接两个变化。less and less 递减。fewer and fewer + 可数。
notes: 不要 more and more louder。
people 用 more and more people。
fewer 接可数。
可与 become/get 连用。
不要和 the more 句型零件混用。

examples.en: The house got noisier and noisier.
examples.cn: 家里变得越来越吵。

examples.en: She became more and more tired.
examples.cn: 她越来越累。

examples.en: Fewer and fewer buses came after nine.
examples.cn: 九点后车越来越少。

examples.en: Mixed waste look more and more like love.
examples.cn: 无偿时数越来越像被叫做爱。

examples.en: Trust grew thinner and thinner.
examples.cn: 信任越来越薄。

examples.en: The statistic looked less and less like a riverbank.
examples.cn: 这统计越来越不像厨房。

exercises.q: The bag is getting ____.
She is becoming ____ tired.
Days are getting ____.
选择正确句子。
options: It is getting colder and colder.
It gets more and more colder.
It is getting cold and colderest.
exercises.answer: It is getting colder and colder.

exercises.q: He feels ____ hungry.
The puppy is growing ____ (big).
The wait is becoming more and more ____ (long).
Nights are getting ____ (dark).
more and more louder 正确。
单音节常用 -er and -er。
汤越来越稠。→ The soup is getting ____.
她越来越累。→ She is becoming ____ tired.
递减：He is more and more sure. → He is ____ sure.
改错：It is getting more and more colder.
exercises.answer: It is getting colder and colder.

exercises.q: 改错：The days are longer and more longer.
exercises.answer: The days are getting longer and longer.

exercises.q: Indoor months became ____.
____ people waited for the recycle truck.
He made ____ mistakes after rest.
Her voice became ____.
The house grew ____ after ten.
Shifts are becoming more and more ____ (long).
Fewer and fewer buses ____ (come) after nine.
The wait felt ____ (long).

grammar.title: will / would 表预测与把握
grammar.titleEn: will / would for Prediction and Certainty
grammar.usage: will 表较确定的预测或当场决定；would 更委婉、把握更低，也可用于假设结果。must 表较有把握的推测；might/could 更不确定。won't 否定预测；would have done 谈未发生的过去结果。be going to 强调已有迹象。高中：I would say / One would have thought。
forms: 主语 + will / won't + 原形（较确定预测）
主语 + would / wouldn't + 原形（委婉预测）
must / might / could + 原形（把握对比）
notes: will 后不加 to，也不加 -s。
would 比 will 软；must 比 would 更有把握。
有云就要下雨常用 be going to / will。
Would you like... 是礼貌，不是预测。
对过去未发生结果用 would have done。
